summary.headline: War and Medical Astrology
summary.text: Astrological and magical prognostic entries from folios 216–232v, including war, sieges, ambushes, military expeditions, letters, sorcery, solar terms, lots, runaways, and medical astrology. The catalog also records the iatromathematics of Hermes Trismegistus to Ammon the Egyptian and prognostics of Galen on illness, births, falls, and wounds, with cross-references to Florentine and Vindobon codices and editions by Camerarius, Ideler, and Kühn.
